name: Beth Arabah
overview: Beth Arabah, also referred to simply as Arabah, is identified in Scripture as a city located in the valley near the Dead Sea. The passages in Joshua (15:6, 15:61, 18:18, 18:22) describe its geographical setting as part of the wilderness and border regions, emphasizing its position within the plain or Arabah. These references highlight Beth Arabah’s role as a landmark city within the tribal boundaries of Israel during the conquest and settlement period.
